# Ariadne v0.8.29 release request

- Tag: `v0.8.29`
- Source: the main commit containing this request.
- Notes: `docs/releases/v0.8.29.md`
- Intent: keep Qdrant running through updates (wait for launchd to release a
  job before bootstrapping it again, with retries) and drain the whole
  consolidation queue in one run instead of deferring what a run-wide deadline
  cut off.
- Verification: Go, native Windows and rendered EN/UK site CI passed on merge
  commit `cb000a3eeefc4eb02315e2536c62c725243c6328`
  ([CI run 44478086282](https://github.com/mclaut/ariadne/actions/runs/44478086282)).
- No data or configuration changes; the consolidation pipeline revision moves
  to `atomic-v3`, so previously deferred batches are reconsidered once.
